comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected into compressed world space via road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world units (~3.3× real metres due to 0.3 scale). Each entry has a stable id assigned at creation — do not renumber. Entries marked needs_owner_review: true have coordinates sourced from map research, not from lived knowledge; owner should verify placement and whether the community is actually passed on the game route.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Where the Palisadoes strip meets the Kingston mainland — the Harbour View roundabout

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community along Windward Road

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: Historic Kingston community between Rollington Town and Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston, along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Eastern Kingston hillside community; birthplace of Count Ossie's nyahbinghi drumming tradition

communities.name: Liguanea
communities.note: Uptown Kingston neighbourhood along the Trafalgar Road corridor

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's central business district — hotels, offices, restaurants

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The crossroads of uptown Kingston — the 1813 clock tower marks the spot

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: St. Catherine community between Spanish Town and Bog Walk

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's original colonial capital — Georgian parade square and cathedral

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Junction community on the approach to Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community in the dramatic Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is the famous one-lane crossing

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine community on the Rio Cobre above Flat Bridge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous since the folk song — Linstead Market draws all of St. Catherine on Saturdays

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann crossroads where the road climbs to the hills — the old Moneague Hotel is a Jamaican institution

communities.name: Cave Valley
communities.note: St. Ann community in the hills between Moneague and Alexandria

communities.name: Alexandria
communities.note: St. Ann market town on the road down to Ocho Rios

communities.name: Steer Town
communities.note: Hillside community at the top of Fern Gully

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist capital of Jamaica's north coast — journey's end at Dunn's River Falls
